title: Yoshi's Woolly World
shortDescription: Yoshi's Woolly World is organized in GameAtlas's Nintendo 3DS family platformer collection with a source-linked record and deterministic catalog context.
highlights: Keeps a documented platformer option visible in the Nintendo 3DS family collection.
Separates the GameAtlas catalog method from the external factual reference.

signals.rationale: Grouped for the Nintendo 3DS family platformer discovery path using the documented Wikidata platform mapping; this remains a catalog record, never an aggregate score.
